title: Seagrove Beach "Casa Blanco" 86 San Roy Road- Main House
h1: Seagrove Beach "Casa Blanco" 86 San Roy Road- Main House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Newly constructed home*- Lake front - Gulf views- Private heated Infinity pool and sitting spa **Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $115 per day** - Complimentary beach setups provided each morning include 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella (service provided March 1-October 31) - 2 Yolo paddle boards- 6-passenger golf cart - 6 adult bikes - Wine bar- Multiple Garages- Full office- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Casa Blanco redefines lakefront luxury! Hosting up to 18 guests, this 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom Seagrove Beach retreat is breathtaking, featuring stunning Gulf views and a sophisticated blend of modern and Mediterranean charm. Featuring a heated infinity pool, sitting spa, and wine bar, it’s the perfect lavish escape for large groups. Picture poolside elegance, peacefully paddleboarding Eastern Lake, or swimming in the beautiful Emerald Coast—only 3 minutes away!Step inside this exquisite 3-story abode, where a stately great room with vaulted ceilings and seamless glass walls provides panoramic views of the shimmering lake. The living area, adorned with plush seating and a Smart TV, flows effortlessly into the nearby wine bar and dining room, seating 12 for formal meals. Cook and create in the gourmet kitchen, boasting high-end appliances and a spacious island with 5 stools—plus an elegant prep kitchen for additional space. Down the hall is a media room with comfy seating for a family movie night, as well as the first-floor primary bedroom, which boasts a king bed, a private bathroom with a spa-like tub, and a fireplace. Outside, the private waterfront terrace offers plush seating, an alfresco dining table, and a BBQ grill—only steps away from the private pool with a sun deck and loungers. A private dock provides easy access to the lake.Upstairs, friends can hang out in the bunk room with a king bed, twin-over-twin bunk, and private bathroom, or recharge in the luxurious primary bedroom, featuring a king bed, private bathroom, and balcony access with great views! A Peloton treadmill-equipped gym and a private office add convenience to the second floor, alongside the laundry room.The cozy third-floor living space includes a kitchenette, comfy seating, and a TV, as well as access to the top-floor balcony boasting 2 porch swings and incredible waterfront views. Guests can choose from 3 inviting accommodations—2 spacious guest bedrooms with king beds and private bathrooms, or 1 bunk room with 2 twin-over-full beds.Casa Blanco delivers the ultimate Seagrove Beach experience, perfect for beach and lake adventures! With parking for 6 vehicles, a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle, and 6 adult bikes, exploring is a breeze. Enjoy the 2 provided Yolo paddleboards for water activities or visit local eateries like The Big Chill and The Red Bar. Beach access is only a 3-minute stroll to Sugar Dunes Beach and Port Property Beach. Book this elegant home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 18):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateTHIRD FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Full Bunkbeds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Please note: The slider doors in the main living room are not for guest use

Hosting up to 18 guests, this 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom Seagrove Beach retreat is breathtaking, featuring stunning Gulf views and a sophisticated blend of modern and Mediterranean charm. Featuring a heated infinity pool, sitting spa, and wine bar, it’s the perfect lavish escape for large groups. Picture poolside elegance, peacefully paddleboarding Eastern Lake, or swimming in the beautiful Emerald Coast—only 3 minutes away! Step inside this exquisite 3-story abode, where a stately great room with vaulted ceilings and seamless glass walls provides panoramic views of the shimmering lake. Down the hall is a media room with comfy seating for a family movie night, as well as the first-floor primary bedroom, which boasts a king bed, a private bathroom with a spa-like tub, and a fireplace. A private dock provides easy access to the lake. Upstairs, friends can hang out in the bunk room with a king bed, twin-over-twin bunk, and private bathroom, or recharge in the luxurious primary bedroom, featuring a king bed, private bathroom, and balcony access with great views! A Peloton treadmill-equipped gym and a private office add convenience to the second floor, alongside the laundry room. The cozy third-floor living space includes a kitchenette, comfy seating, and a TV, as well as access to the top-floor balcony boasting 2 porch swings and incredible waterfront views. Guests can choose from 3 inviting accommodations—2 spacious guest bedrooms with king beds and private bathrooms, or 1 bunk room with 2 twin-over-full beds. Casa Blanco delivers the ultimate Seagrove Beach experience, perfect for beach and lake adventures! With parking for 6 vehicles, a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle, and 6 adult bikes, exploring is a breeze. Enjoy the 2 provided Yolo paddleboards for water activities or visit local eateries like The Big Chill and The Red Bar. Beach access is only a 3-minute stroll to Sugar Dunes Beach and Port Property Beach. Book this elegant home today!
